newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Drilling files for 7 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Drilling files for 7 mln common shrs.

text.p: Falcon Drilling Co Inc said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to seven million common shares.
Of the total, three million common shares are being offered by the company and four million are being sold by selling stockholders, the filing said.

The company and selling stockholders have granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 250,000 additional shares from the company and 800,000 additional shares from selling stockholders, the filing said.
The offering will be made through CS First Boston, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Salomon Brothers Inc, Schroder Wertheim & Co and Simmons & Co International.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 38,546,650 common, the filing said.
The company will use the proceeds to expand the company's deepwater operations through the acquisition of additional rigs and the refurbishment and upgrade of certain of its existing rigs.
Falcon will also use the proceeds to repay amounts of outstanding under the company's working capital facility, the filing said.
Of the selling stockholders, Open Society Institute plans to sell up to two million shares, while Douglas Hamilton, a director since 1992, will offer 1,165,500 common share, the filing said.
Falcon provides contract drilling and workover services for the domestic and international oil and gas industry.
